_default_template_yaml.text:
dataset_path: facebook/belebele
fewshot_config:
  sampler: first_n
output_type: multiple_choice
should_decontaminate: true
doc_to_decontamination_query: "{{question}}"
doc_to_text: "P: {{flores_passage}}\nQ: {{question.strip()}}\nA: {{mc_answer1}}\nB: {{mc_answer2}}\nC: {{mc_answer3}}\nD: {{mc_answer4}}\nAnswer:"
doc_to_choice: ["A", "B", "C", "D"]
doc_to_target: "{{['1', '2', '3', '4'].index(correct_answer_num)}}"
metric_list:
  - metric: acc
    aggregation: mean
    higher_is_better: true
  - metric: acc_norm
    aggregation: mean
    higher_is_better: true
metadata:
  version: 0.0

belebele_eng_Latn.yaml.text:
dataset_name: eng_Latn
fewshot_split: test
include: _default_template_yaml
task: belebele_eng_Latn
test_split: test

belebele_ben_Beng.yaml.text:
dataset_name: ben_Beng
fewshot_split: test
include: _default_template_yaml
task: belebele_ben_Beng
test_split: test

belebele_hin_Deva.yaml.text:
